text_block_list.text:
One day after training, while walking 
around the shopping district with Seiun 
Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Oh? It's quite lively over there."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, a raffle lottery?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when you bought 
snacks earlier, something came with it, 
didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that a raffle ticket!? Oh my 
gosh, what a coincidence☆ We gotta pull 
it!
choice_data_list:
If only they'd just come right out and say 
they want to do it...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huhhh~!? You figured it out!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, and here I went out of my way to 
add some fateful, heart-throbbing 
excitement for you~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well. Naturally, my target is... the 
Onsen Trip!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer! I'll leave the rest to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Managing an Umamusume's motivation is an 
important part of the job! Dangling a hot 
spring trip in front of me will make me 
work super hard☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, charming, isn't it~? Go on, give it 
everything you've got!

With Seiun Sky watching over me... My 
heart pounding, I turned the lever of the 
raffle machine!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oooohh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yay! Hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer magic strikes again! Way to go, 
Master Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right, so when should we go? Tomorrow, 
or the day after?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
How about we head out right after 
training? That way, we can sweat it all 
out after working hard!

Just as I was about to get swept along, it 
hit me. With the Senior year only just 
beginning, I can't let her take a 
leisurely hot spring trip now!
choice_data_list:
Let's do it once we reach a good stopping 
point!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehh?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, did they notice me? Still, not 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aw, don't be so heartless~ It'd be such a 
waste to just keep it on the back burner!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like I said earlier, I can work much 
harder if there's a reward, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if we can go to a hot spring, I'll 
train way harder than ever! Please, pretty 
please~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list:
If you do your best, we can go to the hot 
springs, so keep at it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guh... Is this as far as I go?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Then promise me. Promise that if I work 
hard, you'll take me to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then that means my Trainer is going to 
take care of all my trip preparations and 
everything at the inn for me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's a deal~☆ I'll do my best so 
I can look forward to the hot springs♪

...And so, it was decided that I would 
hold onto the hot spring trip ticket for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa! First prize! Amazing!
choice_data_list: Sorry it's not an actual hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! You're plenty 
amazing as it is!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that Salisbury steak looks so good♪ 
Let's eat it tonight right away!
choice_data_list: Can you eat all that by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Sei-chan is a respectable 
Umamusume too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I don't eat quite as much as 
Spe-chan or Grass-chan, though~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, right. If you're worried, why don't 
you join us, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You're the one who won it in 
the first place, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but Sei-chan is taking the carrots 
first~♪

Afterward, we returned to the academy and 
split the Salisbury steak between the two 
of us... though Seiun Sky casually cut a 
slightly larger portion for me.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing! There are sooo many 
carrots...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...What do I do?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we bring it back to the academy, 
I'm sure tons of girls would want it, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyaha. I just thought of something reeeal 
good☆
(Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right, please line up in order~. Now 
then, let's hear your story.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You know, I heard they're opening a 
hammock spot in the next town over soon!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, that sounds like a great spot for a 
nap~ Since that was good info... here's 5 
carrots!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yay~! Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Sei-chan, my turn next~!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. There are still plenty of 
carrots left, so no rush—just give me some 
good info~

Seiun Sky had found a new way to gather 
information.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ho-hoh, one single carrot.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Why are you apologizing? I'm super happy 
with the carrot! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan's motivation has been preserved! 
Now, if you want to add a little extra to 
it..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
How about eating some piping hot 
croquettes from the shopping district? ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yay~☆ Look at you being so generous, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hot, hot... *pant, pant*.

And so, I watched over Seiun Sky as she 
struggled to eat piping-hot fried food on 
top of the carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, there's no need to apologize! It's 
down to luck, so it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Can't be helped if Sei-chan's motivation 
drops, right? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. My mood's kind of like 
luck—totally unpredictable~

The next day. As expected, Seiun Sky 
showed up late for training...
